villagemaster/32157.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Moka: Ah, my young friend, what brings you to me? I am too busy to even grab a bite to eat, so you best make it quick! What is with this Isle of Souls? I've been digging and digging and found not one useful stone in this blasted land! Hey, Fisher, what do you think? Huh? And why all…
